verses.text: By David. The LORD is my light and my salvation. Who should I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Who could scare me?
When people came at me like they wanted to eat me alive, my enemies were the ones who stumbled and fell.
Even if an army camps around me, my heart won't be afraid. Even if war breaks out against me, I'll stay confident.
One thing I've asked of the LORD, and I'll keep seeking it: to live in his house every day of my life, to see his beauty and seek him in his temple.
When trouble hits, he'll shelter me in his pavilion. He'll hide me in the safest part of his tent and set me high on a rock.
Then I'll hold my head high above the enemies around me. I'll bring joyful sacrifices to his tent and sing my praises to the LORD. 🎶
LORD, hear me when I call out. Show me mercy and answer me.
You said, “Seek my face.” My heart answered, “LORD, I'll seek your face.”
Please don't hide your face or turn your servant away in anger. You've been my help. Don't leave me or give up on me, God who saves me.
Even if my father and mother leave me, the LORD will take me in.
Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me on a straight path with my enemies watching.
Don't hand me over to what my enemies want. People have stood up to lie about me, and they're breathing threats.
I'm still sure I'll see the LORD's goodness in the land of the living.
Wait for the LORD. Stay strong and take heart. Yes, wait for the LORD.
